prompt: I lost a final against Greg Rusedski on grass, who won his 4th career singles title on grass against a player that once defeated me in the opening round of the US Open. I achieved my highest ranking in singles on what date?
answer:
You were **Mark Woodforde**. Greg Rusedski defeated Woodforde in the 1995 Newport final, while Rusedski later won his fourth career singles title at Nottingham in 1996 by defeating MaliVai Washington—who had beaten Woodforde in the first round of the 1996 US Open.

Woodforde reached his highest singles ranking, **world No. 19, on November 16, 1992**.
